|strategy=By Joe Helfrich<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/tatooine/dark/small/watto.html</ref>

When you take your first glance at the [[Skywalkers]]' owner, you may notice that the game text box is a little bare! No piloting, no warrior, and only ability two. Deploy 2 and forfeit 4 are good for a Dark Side alien, destiny 3 is a great thing for a character, and landspeed of 2 doesn't hurt around the deserts of [[Tatooine (Dark){{!}}Tatooine]], but what's this gambler's real strength?

It's his ability to grab [[Watto's Chance Cube]]. That Used Interrupt is a risky one, but it is a Used battle destiny adder (if you "play your cards right") with a destiny of 5 &#150; it partners [[Watto]] well. And with his landspeed letting him change sites quickly, he might be able to swing a battle in your favor &#150; as long as your opponent doesn't go [[Changing The Odds]].
